collection.title: VW Golf Hatchback 2002 to 2003 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A VW Golf Hatchback 2002 to 2003 model requires a 21" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 19" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Side Pin arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also have the rear blade for this Golf Hatchback, simply click the Rear Blades tab below.
